title: Test case 1 — Glassing in a hotel (s 17, early plea, no priors)
shows: The main path: no category or mandatory minimum, so the full range of dispositions is open. The app weighs imprisonment against a combination sentence or a CCO in the light of the Manual's guidance on glassing, states the s 6AAA notional sentence for the early plea, and the hard checks require the mandatory alcohol exclusion order (intoxication by liquor contributed).
